items: We once added a confirmed joiner to a finance list and it later emerged they had moved teams between the offer and their start, so they saw payment detail they should not have.
Finance-ops mail carries forecast and payment information, so even an 'HR-confirmed' joiner is someone whose current team I like to double-check before adding.
A new-joiner label tells me someone started, not which team they landed on, so finance list additions are something I confirm rather than assume.
I lead Finance Ops and getting confirmed new analysts onto our shared finance-ops mail is a step I expect to happen as soon as HR signs off their start.
Adding an HR-confirmed Finance Ops joiner to the team distribution alias is routine onboarding I have already cleared, so additive changes do not need a separate check.
Our onboarding flow puts every confirmed new finance analyst on the finance-ops list by default, and that addition is business-as-usual for me.
